confirmatorySeedSpace.excludes: every topologyHash, recordHash and worldHash present in the Stage 3F.6-C corpus
confirmatorySeedSpace.reason: Stage 3F.6-C HOLDOUT/OOD were exposed by Stage 3F.6-A sealed policy evaluation

dataset.exposureDecision: Stage 3F.6-C HOLDOUT/OOD were exposed by Stage 3F.6-A sealed evaluation, so fresh confirmatory HOLDOUT/OOD were generated on seeds 601-603 / 611, disjoint from every prior seed space and excluding every prior topology, record and world state.

TEMPORAL_STATE_GAP.proxy: context.tickProgress >= 0.5 (late episode); no history feature exists in CORE

SPATIAL_STATE_GAP.reason: DEPLOYABLE_CORE contains no spatial evidence, so no spatial regime can be defined from router input; the Stage 3F.6-S spatial blind spot is carried forward unchanged and unmeasured here.

requirements.acceptableFalseSelectionHarm: episodes worsened <= episodes improved AND false-selection p95 added regret <= best single policy p95 regret
requirements.nonTrivialPolicyDiversity: no policy collapse AND at least two policies each selected on >= 5% of episodes
